description: Audit a Base wallet address in one call: high/medium/low risk verdict with named flags (no history, single tx, low balance+low activity, contract), token holdings of 4 major tokens (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, DAI), on-chain labels (high ETH holder, active small holder, new address), and transaction count. Use for trader due diligence, suspicious address checks, and before sending a payment or trade to an address. Costs $0.02 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
name: wallet-audit
